trustDescription: Restricted Mode: trust this workspace before using context or running a task.
virtualDescription: Local desktop only: Windows x64, macOS arm64 or Linux x64, with file workspaces. Remote, virtual and web are unsupported.
endpointDescription: Tomverse coding API base URL. Only user settings are used; workspace settings and environment variables are ignored.
localhostDescription: Allow HTTP on localhost for local development only. Disabled by default.
persistDescription: Keep sessions and Undo backups in local extension storage. Disable for memory-only sessions without resume after exit.
